info.scriptSrcText: property this, Xpos, radians, Ypos, loopX, loopWidth, bergFront, tiltVel, tiltAngle, COPTER, snowBlowglobal gXVel, gXOffset, gPaused, gTileIDList, gXVelChangeon beginSprite  radians = float(PI / 180)  this = sprite(the currentSpriteNum)  bergFront = sprite(the currentSpriteNum + 1)  snowBlow = sprite(56)  loopX = gTileIDList.count * 128 * 0.5  loopWidth = gTileIDList.count * 128  Xpos = float(this.locH)  COPTER = sprite(5)  this.locZ = 50  bergFront.locZ = 1100  bergFront.blend = 50  tiltAngle = 0.0  tiltVel = 0.0endon exitFrame  if gPaused = 0 then    Xpos = Xpos + gXVel + gXOffset    if Xpos > loopX then      Xpos = Xpos - loopWidth    end if    if Xpos < -loopX then      Xpos = Xpos + loopWidth    end if    if (Xpos > 0) and (Xpos < 512) then      xDiff = COPTER.locH - this.locH      yDiff = COPTER.locV - this.locV      if (abs(xDiff) < 60) and (yDiff > -90) and (yDiff < -20) then        snowBlow.locH = COPTER.locH        snowBlow.locV = this.locV - 20        snowBlow.rotation = 0        if xDiff > 0 then          tiltVel = tiltVel + ((90 - yDiff) * 0.001)        else          tiltVel = tiltVel - ((90 - yDiff) * 0.001)        end if      end if      tiltVel = tiltVel - (tiltAngle * 0.005)      tiltVel = tiltVel * 0.90000000000000002      tiltAngle = tiltAngle + tiltVel    end if    this.rotation = tiltAngle    this.locH = Xpos    bergFront.loc = this.loc    bergFront.rotation = tiltAngle  end ifend
